_comment: 10.3788 is Chinese Laser Press, not SPIE: https://doi.org/10.3788/PI.2023.R05
resolves to researching.cn. Photonics Insights is co-published, so the same
article also sits on spiedigitallibrary.org, and only that copy has the
fulltext API the SPIE handler uses (the API answers from the article's own
page, not from the SPIE homepage, so the URL cannot be derived from the DOI).
Passing "link" skips doi.org and lands the run straight on the SPIE page,
